name: tetherproof
description: TetherProof - a verified capability and execution network

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tetherproof/shared && npm run build --workspace @tetherproof/api && npm run build --workspace @tetherproof/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --workspace @tetherproof/api" "npm run dev --workspace @tetherproof/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @tetherproof/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @tetherproof/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
